overview.description: The iShares Core S&P 500 ETF (IVV) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of US large- and mid-cap stocks selected by the S&P Committee. IVV was launched on May 15, 2000 and is issued by BlackRock.
